## Purpose

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behaviour.

## Scope

List changed dependencies, network/download sources, permissions, build steps,
and any application behaviour changes. Identify changes to branding, donation
links, licensing, or release configuration explicitly.

## Validation

Describe what was actually built or tested and where. List remaining limitations.

## Development assistance

Disclose relevant generated code or packaging assistance and upstream sources.
For Flathub-specific work, independently follow its current AI and submission
rules; this generic upstream template is not a Flathub submission template.
